feature: Officer-reviewed targeted drive announcements and manual in-app reminders
scope: No email/SMS delivery, automatic timer, scoring change or new dependency

local.database: Local PostgreSQL under a restricted application role

final_focused_retest.reason: Correct the synthetic application fixture to include the ordinary frozen matching evidence consumed by the calendar reader; no product change

browser_walkthrough.environment: localhost API and Vite backed by the real local test database; synthetic fixtures only
browser_walkthrough.published_audience: College student-role accounts narrowed to the fixture's CSE branch
browser_walkthrough.student_feed: Manual drive reminder with frozen drive/company context and an applications link
browser_walkthrough.read_receipt: Student marked the notice read; refreshed administrator history showed one read and the owning recipient's timestamp
browser_walkthrough.recipient_first_page: Ten of twelve publication-time identity snapshots and the current read time observed
browser_walkthrough.second_page: Covered by the automated pagination case; optional browser check ended when the local session returned to sign-in

security_and_integrity_cases: Current student role and real-college verified/approved admission
Applicants, effective shortlist with independent rejection vetoes, scheduled status and explicit college-wide targeting
Normalized branch filters and whole-audience stale-preview detection beyond the ten-person sample
Concurrent same-key retries and conflicting-content refusal
Atomic rollback on a partial notification insertion failure
Recipient-owned read status and paginated frozen identities
Contextless and cross-college SQL reads/writes on both new FORCE-RLS tables
local.swagger: All five announcement endpoint methods visible in local /docs; authenticated behavior exercised by integration cases and the browser walkthrough
local.final_read_only_review: No authorization, tenant-filter, transaction or concurrency blockers

limitations: Read means explicitly marked read, not email delivery, attendance or comprehension
Scheduled audience includes any booking still marked scheduled, including past bookings with unrecorded outcomes
Retries retain their identifier while the browser draft remains mounted; after leaving/reloading check history before creating a new notice
Independent application/account/profile writers are not reserved by publication; the audience is frozen at its query
No edit, retract or delete action; publish corrections separately
Branch filtering accepts at most eighty normalized characters; unusual Unicode uppercase expansion can exceed that limit
Actual Gmail receipt and real-college administrator onboarding remain separate unverified tasks
